flags: No cache source establishes who created or campaigned for the modern byway, or its designation date. Overview uses the documented campaign history without presenting it as highway construction history.

Official tourism route is 126 miles; material maps 80 miles. Strip mileage runs from Sharpsburg toward Poolesville, opposite the official itinerary. Moments follow the official White’s Ferry-to-Sharpsburg direction, using the strip in reverse.
Ferry closure is supported only by cached Wikipedia, not a current operator notice. July 2026 purchase negotiations do not establish reopening. Checked date means cache review only.

Tourism page places Lincoln’s battlefield visit before September 22; this chronology is not reused. Its cavalry-clash account also differs from Poolesville’s categorical no-battles statement; clash claim omitted.
Current Sugarloaf lookout/crossing claim is supported by Wikipedia but omitted because the tourism page treats Sugarloaf as an excursion. No unsupported current factual claim needed to be retained.
Tolson’s Chapel interior features are documented, but current interior access is not established. No admission promise is made.
